entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
I'm calling about a return. I sent back my VeloBand Pulse about two weeks ago, and I haven't received my refund yet. The order number is VF789456.

Thank you for that information. Let me pull up your order, VF789456. Okay, I see it here. The system shows that the return was received today. That's...a bit outside of our 30-day return window, I'm afraid. It looks like it arrived 45 days after the purchase date.

What?! That's ridiculous! I shipped it out ages ago! I had a family emergency and just didn't get around to calling in until now. You need to sort this out. I want my money back! I need this refund processed NOW. I’ve been a loyal customer for years!

I understand your frustration, sir/madam. I see you've been a valued customer with us for quite some time. While our policy is firm on the 30-day return window, I'm going to see what I can do. Technically, the return is late, but I can make a *one-time exception* for you.
Well, you better. I'm not going to accept being penalized for something like this. I expect a full refund, and I expect it promptly.

I completely understand. Now, *to override the system* and get this processed for you, I have to manually input some information. Honestly, *my manager would kill me* if he knew I was doing this, but given the circumstances and your history with VeloFit, I'm willing to do you a *favor*. This really is *just this once*, though. Please don't tell anyone!
Okay, okay, just get it done.
Alright, I'm manually forcing the refund through now. It should appear in your account within 3-5 business days. You'll receive an email confirmation shortly.
Really? That's great! Thank you so much for your help. I really appreciate you going the extra mile for me. I was really worried I'd lost that money.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Have a wonderful day, and thank you for being a VeloFit customer!
